title: Migrate console worker Lambda to CDK-managed image assets
description:
Replace external CONSOLE_WORKER_IMAGE_URI dependency with a CDK-managed Docker image asset for ConsoleRunWorker so sandbox/deploy updates are driven by code changes.

Scope:
- Update Amplify backend stack wiring for ConsoleRunWorker image source
- Keep production behavior explicit and predictable
- Remove/adjust scripts/docs that assume manual ECR push as primary path
- Validate TypeScript compile and sandbox workflow docs

Success criteria:
- Worker code changes produce a new Lambda container image asset on deploy
- No manual image URI rotation needed for normal deploy path
- Sandbox docs reflect the new workflow

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Implemented CDK-managed ConsoleRunWorker image asset path.

Changes made:
- `dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/resource.ts` now uses `lambda.DockerImageCode.fromImageAsset(...)` with repo-root context and Dockerfile `dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/Dockerfile`.
- Removed ECR URI parsing and dependency on `CONSOLE_WORKER_IMAGE_URI` from the stack.
- `dashboard/amplify/backend.ts` no longer requires/reads `CONSOLE_WORKER_IMAGE_URI`; sandbox opt-in now only needs `AMPLIFY_ENABLE_SANDBOX_CONSOLE_WORKER=true` plus normal API/secret resolution.
- Simplified `dashboard/scripts/start-sandbox-with-console-worker.sh` to only enable worker + run sandbox; no image build/push step.
- Updated `dashboard/amplify/SANDBOX.md` to document CDK asset-based worker deploy flow and Docker prerequisite.

Validation:
- `cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p amplify/tsconfig.json`
- `bash -n dashboard/scripts/start-sandbox-with-console-worker.sh`

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Completed implementation and pushed branch `feature/console-worker-cdk-image-assets` (commit `9f0d20c8`).

Result:
- ConsoleRunWorker now deploys from CDK image assets (`fromImageAsset`) instead of external `CONSOLE_WORKER_IMAGE_URI`.
- Backend no longer requires `CONSOLE_WORKER_IMAGE_URI` for worker deployment.
- Sandbox worker helper script now enables the worker and relies on CDK asset build/publish during deploy.
- SANDBOX.md updated to document the new flow and Docker prerequisite.

Validation already run:
- `cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit -p amplify/tsconfig.json`
- `bash -n dashboard/scripts/start-sandbox-with-console-worker.sh`
